QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Empty Paddock
QuestInfo.0: Gurnardson has finally allowed you into Svarti's perimeter, but for some reason, he's leading you to an empty paddock. His cruelty is beyond infuriating, but Svarti has suffered heavy losses as well, so you should probably try to be patient with him.
